newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila firm plans to purchase 10,000 T U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Manila firm plans to purchase 10,000 T U.S. wheat.

text.p: A Philippine milling company has invited tenders for 10,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat for November shipment, Manila traders said on Tuesday.
"The company wants 10,000 tonnes of combined dark northern spring wheat and western white wheat. They will decide to buy on Wednesday," said one trader.
The trader said the flour mill is waiting for U.S. wheat prices to soften further. Futures price of spring wheat is now at $4.05 a bushel and western white wheat at $3.82 a bushel.
Delivery of the wheat is expected by late November.
